notes.title: 2.1.0 Update
notes.content:
We have released an update today, October 24th.

[list]
[*] Progress made during dungeon exploration will now be automatically saved. We have adjusted the game so that when you restart after exiting, you will resume from the point where the previous game over occurred.
[*] Adjusted the behavior of the items "🧲" and "🌞".
[*] Fixed several bugs.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support.
